theorems.name: Submission.tangentMeasure_zero_dim_carrier
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)), (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal c ≤ μ (Metric.ball x ρ)) → ∃ R : Set (Rn N), MeasurableSet R ∧ CountablyRectifiable 0 R ∧ μ Rᶜ = 0
